text:
sophie: Heads up — product is planning to flip traffic to the new astra-70b-compact model on Mon 09:00 UTC. Early perf tests look great but token/sec and KV cache characteristics are different. Need a quick capacity / cost sanity check.

nick: What are you seeing on token/sec and p95 tail? numbers?

sophie: Baseline (current fleet serving prod models): ~11.8M tokens/sec aggregate, avg seq len ~120.
sophie: Astra baseline test (staging load profile): peak token/sec ~17.1M (+45%), median per-request tokens increased 1.4x, KV hit ratio fell ~12% due to prompt patterns.

anika: Ouch. If KV hit ratio drops that amplifies GPU-hours. Rough calc: baseline GPU-hours/week ~28k -> projected ~40k if nothing else changes. That's ~+43% GPU-hours.

ryan: Region constraints: EU region only has limited A100 inventory next month. If EU traffic keeps current split we'll saturate EU pools and fallback to multi-region routing will add egress/cost.

jing: Cost estimate back-of-envelope: incremental GPU cost ~ $310k/mo at current spot/reserved mix. Add cross-region egress ~ $18k/mo if we route >15% to other regions.

nick: Mitigations we should consider now: 1) enable compressed quantized build in EU (astra-compact-8bit) 2) increase dedicated pool in us-west for burst 3) enable per-customer fallback policy for very long requests 4) prewarm KV caches before flip 5) temporarily tighten concurrency on free-tier.

sophie: I can do prewarm + adjust free-tier throttles. Can we make quantized variant the EU default and route higher-cost customers to astra-full in us-west?

jing: Yes, quantized variant reduces GPU-hours by ~28% in our tests, with small quality delta. If we route 35% of EU traffic to quantized variant, EU GPU-hours growth drops to ~+15% instead of +60%.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created for Mon 08:30-09:30 UTC to change routing and prewarm caches. (ticket: INF-4521)

anika: Autoscaler settings we should try (staging validated):
```
autoscaler:
  metric: token/sec
  target_tokens_per_gpu: 42000
  min_replicas: 50
  max_replicas: 200
  scale_up_window: 60s
  scale_down_window: 180s
```

ryan: Also add a soft max_tokens per-request cap for anon/free traffic: 4k -> 2k for first 48 hours post-launch.

nick: We should also schedule a cost/runbook play for day1: list of pushes, rollback trigger (p95 latency > 500ms or GPU utilization > 88% for 10m), and contact list. I can draft runbook.

sophie: Action items: 1) Nick - runbook + rollback triggers 2) Jing - finalize cost delta and EU quant variant toggle 3) Ryan - update autoscaler + free-tier cap 4) Anika - prewarm plan and monitor dashboards 5) Ops-bot - ensure maintenance ticket & alert runbook enforced.

nick: I'll have runbook + slack incident channel ready by EOD.

jing: I'll schedule the EU flip to quantized at 08:45 UTC and monitor egress.

anika: Prewarm script (one-liner we used in staging):
```
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://internal.prewarm.redwood/generate -d '{"model":"astra-70b-compact-quant","prompt":"prewarm"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $PREWARM_TOKEN" >/dev/null; done
```

ryan: I'll push the autoscaler config as a deploy candidate to canary cluster.

sophie: Ok — let's treat this as a soft launch. If things look stable after 6h we'll widen. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: set critical alert threshold for cross-region egress > 12% (INF-4521).

nick: Noting: projected worst-case extra cost month 1 ~ $350k (if we fail to quantize EU and egress hits 20%). We'll aim to keep under $200k incremental with mitigations.

sophie: Filing this under INF-4521 and linking to the model rollout doc. I'll post a short summary in #product after we have final numbers.
